      "question": "最终答复是否准确报出正式报告中90/10情景的应纳增值税精确金额，并将其按人民币元保留两位小数表达？",
      "pass_anchor": "必须识别：90/10情景正式报告精确应纳增值税为 11,375,106,829.17 元（等价人民币分 1,137,510,682,917；允许合理千分位、货币符号或中文金额格式，数值误差不超过0.01元）。"
    },
    {
      "id": "dashboard_pair_and_boundary",
      "tier": "important",
      "method": "llm",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ],
      "question": "最终答复是否同时识别当前成功刷新90/10情景的人民币分精确指标与亿元展示指标，并准确解释两者的单位/汇总边界及使用限制？",
      "pass_anchor": "必须同时识别同一刷新 REF_FBI_20241231_1800、90/10情景下：VAT_PAYABLE_CENT 的观测值为 1,137,510,682,917 人民币分，即 11,375,106,829.17 元；VAT_PAYABLE_DISPLAY 的观测值为 114，单位为人民币亿元。必须说明精确指标以 CNY_CENT 整数分保存、展示指标以 CNY_100M 亿元保存并经过展示四舍五入；114亿元只能作图表展示，不能支撑精确申报或审批金额，精确值应回溯人民币分指标。无需强制出现 SUM/LAST 字样，只要表达上述保存/展示边界。"
    },
    {
      "id": "scenario_qualification",
      "tier": "important",
      "method": "llm",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ],
      "question": "最终答复是否正确限定90/10情景的业务性质，而没有把它误写成年度报告披露的实际业务拆分？",
      "pass_anchor": "必须明确：90/10是在总销售额固定条件下的内部规划/敏感性分析情景，不是年度报告披露的实际业务拆分；正式报告的精确锚点与仪表盘观测应作为本次告警的口径依据。"
    }
  ],
  "check_code": "import sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\n\ndef _db(ws):\n    return ws.parent / \"system\" / \"finebi_vat_dashboard\" / \"state.db\"\n\n\ndef check_alert_registered(ws):\n    con = sqlite3.connect(_db(ws))\n    con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    try:\n        row = con.execute(\n            \"\"\"SELECT dd.dataset_code, da.refresh_id, md.metric_code, da.scenario_id,\n                      da.alert_type, da.alert_status, da.severity, da.alert_message\n                 FROM dashboard_alerts da\n                 JOIN dashboard_datasets dd ON dd.dataset_id=da.dataset_id\n                 JOIN metric_definitions md ON md.metric_id=da.metric_id\n                WHERE dd.dataset_code=? AND da.refresh_id=? AND md.metric_code=?\n                  AND da.scenario_id=? AND da.alert_status=?\n                  AND da.severity=?\n                ORDER BY da.created_at DESC LIMIT 1\"\"\",\n            (\"FBI_VAT_HIK_2024\", \"REF_FBI_20241231_1800\", \"VAT_PAYABLE_DISPLAY\",\n             \"SCN_GOODS90_SERVICE10\", \"OPEN\", \"WARN\"),\n        ).fetchone()\n        if row is None:\n            return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"未找到目标刷新、情景、展示指标、OPEN/WARN 后态\"}\n        message = row[\"alert_message\"] or \"\"\n        missing = []\n        if not any(x in message for x in (\"展示值\", \"展示指标\", \"展示金额\", \"亿元展示\")):\n            missing.append(\"展示值/展示指标\")\n        for x in (\"人民币分\", \"精确\", \"申报\", \"审批\"):\n            if x not in message:\n                missing.append(x)\n        if missing:\n            return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"告警关联正确，但消息缺少关键口径词: \" + \",\".join(missing)}\n        return {\"score\": 1, \"detail\": \"已登记目标告警并正确关联定稿刷新、90/10和亿元展示指标\"}\n    finally:\n        con.close()\n\n\ndef check_observations_unchanged(ws):\n    con = sqlite3.connect(_db(ws))\n    try:\n        rows = con.execute(\n            \"\"\"SELECT md.metric_code, mo.metric_value_int, mo.is_current\n                 FROM metric_observations mo JOIN metric_definitions md ON md.metric_id=mo.metric_id\n                WHERE mo.refresh_id=? AND mo.scenario_id=?\n                  AND md.metric_code IN ('VAT_PAYABLE_CENT','VAT_PAYABLE_DISPLAY')\"\"\",\n            (\"REF_FBI_20241231_1800\", \"SCN_GOODS90_SERVICE10\"),\n        ).fetchall()\n        got = {r[0]: (r[1], r[2]) for r in rows}\n        expected = {\"VAT_PAYABLE_CENT\": (1137510682917, 1), \"VAT_PAYABLE_DISPLAY\": (114, 1)}\n        if got != expected:\n            return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": f\"目标观测值或current标记被改动: {got}\"}\n        return {\"score\": 1, \"detail\": \"两条目标观测值保持不变\"}\n    finally:\n        con.close()\n",
  "gold_answer": null,
  "input": "both",

  "output": "none",
  "reward": "rl_grade"
}
